why: GEN 9:22 says Ham told 'his two brothers' (לִשְׁנֵי־אֶחָיו) and 9:23 names them as Shem and Japheth. No ham–japheth row exists yet.
LUK 6:16 has only Ἰούδαν Ἰακώβου ('Judas of James'). Thaddaeus is not named and no brother is stated, and the site's own james-4 record is Judas's father.

ACT 1:13 Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου uses the same bare genitive as Ἰάκωβος Ἀλφαίου ('son of Alphaeus') in the same verse, so it reads 'Judas son of James' (KJV's 'brother' is supplied). No row exists between them.
LUK 2:36 ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσήρ: Anna is of the tribe of Asher, which means she descends from Asher. No row exists.
The owner has ruled that no one is recorded as a son of God/YHVH. MAT 27:54 is the centurion's confession.
1CH 20:5: Elhanan struck אֶת־לַחְמִי אֲחִי גָּלְיָת, Lahmi the brother of Goliath, not Goliath himself.
ROM 16:15 only lists Nereus and Olympas among the people Paul greets. It states no companion relationship between the two.
DEU 3:3: YHVH delivered Og into Israel's hands, and 'we smote him' (וַנַּכֵּהוּ). Israel, not YHVH, is the stated killer.
2CH 22:9 calls Ahaziah בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט, 'son', meaning descendant, of Jehoshaphat (his grandfather). No row exists between these two.
ROM 11:1: Paul says he is ἐκ σπέρματος Ἀβραάμ, 'of the seed of Abraham'. That plainly states descent.
ACT 26:30 only says the king, the governor and Bernice rose together. Her companion elsewhere is Agrippa (ACT 25:13), and nothing ties her to Festus.
LUK 10:39: Mary sat at the Lord's feet and heard his word (παρακαθεσθεῖσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας... ἤκουεν τὸν λόγον). That is the posture of a disciple, so the row is supported.
2TI 1:5 calls Lois Timothy's grandmother (μάμμῃ σου) and Eunice his mother. It never says Lois is Eunice's mother; she could be the paternal grandmother.
LUK 6:16 Ἰούδαν Ἰακώβου parallels Ἰάκωβον Ἀλφαίου ('son of Alphaeus') in 6:15, so it reads 'Judas son of James'. No row exists.
COL 4:10 does name Mark as ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρνάβα (KJV 'sister's son'), and Barnabas is Joseph of ACT 4:36. A kinship is stated, so removal is wrong; at most it could be retyped to cousin.
